summary: Global Asset Management Group, Inc. (GAMG), through its wholly owned subsidiary Sustainable Properties, LLC, acquired G O Landscaping, Inc. via a Stock Purchase Agreement with the Sellers on August 18, 2026, closing August 26, 2026. The $1,820,000 purchase price was paid with 840,000 restricted shares (420,000 per Seller) and a $980,000 secured Convertible Promissory Note with 6% simple interest, maturing August 31, 2029. The note allows conversion at 85% of the 30-day VWAP, with no floor or cap, and is reducible by refinancing proceeds. Watch for stock dilution and conversion effects on share price.
